title: Review of c31's crawlers from noise (SIBM): cells and their layer replicate on seed 5, but no single track crawls 3 body lengths (max 1.65 sqrt(area)) by t=16
summary: Fresh seed 5 with the claimed command (world copied unchanged, 80 frames, t=16): the thresholded random field rounds up into ~10 cells by t~1, larger ones polarize into half-moons and crawl, and crawlers absorb the static cells they touch (5 merges, 2 components at the end). The s layer is membrane-like (rim/core 3.82, rim/out 7.13, 19/22 individuals). Motion per labkit track, net displacement / sqrt(median area) with the periodic unwrap and no area jump above 25%: 1.65, 1.28, 1.11 and 0.78 body lengths for the four moving tracks; every track ends at a merge before it covers 3 body lengths.

observations.S: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=0: thresholded smoothed random field over the whole box
observations.I: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=0.6-16: discrete round cells and half-moon crawlers
observations.B: rerun/seed5/FACTS.md: s peaks at rho=0.95, rim/core 3.82, rim/out 7.13, 19/22 individuals membrane-like; made by the cell's own bound polarity protein (kp*phi*rho), so the drift-placed layer is self-made (L3 quasi-equilibrium clause)
observations.M: rerun/seed5/metrics.json motion_top: the moving tracks 16, 26, 29, 27 cover 1.65, 1.28, 1.11, 0.78 sqrt(area) (half-moons moving broadside, so sqrt(area) is the unit); each track ends at a merge with a static cell (sheet t=6.2-7, 11.2-11.8) before 3 body lengths

seeds_run.result: partial: cells, polarization and layer reproduce; no track reaches 3 body lengths (max 1.65)

not_checked: SRC=none and KIN=1 controls (the claim ran them)
verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed at the claimed length t=16. The crawlers clearly self-propel, but coarsening by absorption breaks every track at a merge before 3 body lengths, so the M gate is not met on this seed; c39's longer re-issue (20261026T1042) is the better vehicle for M. The layer does no work here.
